entities.title: zazzle invoker
entities.summary: The client half of zazzle/zazzled: a tiny C program that hands its command line, standard streams and working directory to the zazzled daemon and exits with the daemon's status, or replaces itself with zazzled or a standalone tool for the commands that run as their own process. Run as `zazz`, or under an installed zazz script's name, it sends zazz requests instead.
entities.purpose: Builds `zazzle` with make, without libc on Linux and with only what libSystem must provide on macOS, so that each zazzle command costs little more than starting a process. Holds the Makefile, the README (what it does, build and test), the source in src/, the tests in test/ and the latency benchmarks in bench/.
boundaries: The daemon, its commands and the wire protocol live in macos/rust/zazzled; zazzled must be built before the smoke test or the benchmarks can run.
`zazzle free-disk-space` and `zazzle fix-network` run the binaries of macos/rust/free-disk-space and macos/rust/fix-network, found beside the invoker; this folder only execs them.
The release ships the same build twice, as zazzle and as zazz, and `zazz install` links script commands to it; what zazz requests do is zazzled's (macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz).
build/ is build output and is ignored by git.
